payment_anxiety.description: User fears financial loss, transaction failure, or hidden charges.
payment_anxiety.cross_question:
Kya paisa bank se deduct hua?
  1. Haan
  2. Nahi

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Gateway Auto-Refund Worker
REQUIREMENT: Order Reconciliation Job & Push Notification

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Orphaned Payment Matcher & Automated Reversal
REQUIREMENT: Client-side Failure State Retry Logic

trust_deficit.description: User fears data theft, spam, or privacy invasion.
trust_deficit.cross_question:
Data privacy kis level ki chahiye?
  1. Standard Data Protection
  2. Highly Sensitive (Medical/Financial)

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Encrypted Database & Standard JWT Auth

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: E2E Encryption & PII Masking

dependency_questions.question:
Kya third-party SDKs ko data access hoga?
  1. Haan, analytics ke liye
  2. Nahi, strict zero-trust

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Anonymous Data Pipelines & GDPR Compliance Module

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Air-gapped Architecture & Self-hosted Analytics

performance_frustration.description: User is experiencing slow load times, crashes, or lag.
performance_frustration.cross_question:
Problem kis layer mein hai?
  1. App start hote hi slow hai (Frontend)
  2. Data aane mein time lag raha hai (Backend/Network)

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Code Splitting, Asset Minification & Offline Skeleton UI

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: API Caching & CDN

dependency_questions.question:
Kya real-time data sync zaruri hai?
  1. Haan, live data chahiye
  2. Nahi, thodi der ka delay chalega

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: WebSocket connection & In-memory Redis

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Stale-While-Revalidate caching strategy

support_isolation.description: User feels disconnected or cannot reach a human agent.
support_isolation.cross_question:
Kya user direct agent se baat karna chahta hai?
  1. Haan, bot nahi chahiye
  2. Nahi, hybrid approach chalegi

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Call Center Routing & Live Agent Chat System

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: AI Bot with human handover API

account_recovery_pain.description: User is locked out or struggling to reset password.
account_recovery_pain.cross_question:
Recovery authentication method kya hoga?
  1. Standard Email link
  2. SMS OTP & Biometrics

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Standard Magic Link Recovery

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Multi-Factor Recovery Pipeline

otp_failure.description: OTP is delayed or failing entirely.
otp_failure.cross_question:
Kya OTP delivery international users ke liye bhi hai?
  1. Haan, Global
  2. Sirf Local (India)

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Twilio/MessageBird Auto-Failover Gateway

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Local DLT Registered Gateway with WhatsApp Fallback

dependency_questions.question:
Agar SMS fail ho jaye toh next step?
  1. Call OTP (IVR)
  2. WhatsApp OTP

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Twilio Programmable Voice OTP

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: WhatsApp Business API OTP Service

notification_spam.description: User is annoyed by too many alerts.
notification_spam.cross_question:
Notifications ka primary purpose kya hai?
  1. Marketing/Promotional
  2. Transactional/Critical

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Granular Opt-in Notification Preferences UI

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: High-Priority Transactional Queue (No-Mute Critical)

search_failure.description: User cannot find what they are looking for.
search_failure.cross_question:
Data search pattern kaisa hai?
  1. Exact matching (SKU, IDs)
  2. Fuzzy/Semantic matching (Natural queries)

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Standard SQL Indexing

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: ElasticSearch with Typo Tolerance

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Redis Search Autocomplete Index

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Basic Full-Text Search

checkout_abandonment.description: User drops off during payment flow.
checkout_abandonment.cross_question:
Checkout friction kahan hai?
  1. Account creation mandatory hai
  2. Payment options kam hain

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Guest Checkout Flow & Lazy Registration

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Integrated Payment Aggregator (Razorpay/Stripe)

support_delay.description: User gets a late response from customer care.
support_delay.cross_question:
Traffic volume kaisa hai support pe?
  1. High volume (1000+ tickets/day)
  2. Low volume

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Zendesk/Intercom integration with SLA tracking

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Simple Email-to-Ticket pipeline

onboarding_dropoff.cross_question:
Data collect karna kitna zaruri hai day-1 pe?
  1. Basic info (Name/Email) kaafi hai
  2. Detailed profile chahiye (e.g., KYC)

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Social Login (OAuth) & 1-Click Signup

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Chunked Multi-Step Form with Progress Resumption

data_sync_delay.description: Data doesn't sync across devices or works poorly offline.
data_sync_delay.cross_question:
Kya app offline kaam karni chahiye?
  1. Haan, full offline support
  2. Sirf network hone par

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: WatermelonDB / SQLite with Background Sync Worker

dependency_questions.question:
Sync conflict resolve kaise honge?
  1. Last write wins
  2. Manual resolution prompt

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: CRDTs (Conflict-free Replicated Data Types)

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Conflict Queue UI Layer
REQUIREMENT: Standard REST API

media_upload_failure.description: Images or videos failing to upload.
media_upload_failure.cross_question:
Upload format kya hai?
  1. Heavy Videos (GBs)
  2. Basic Images (MBs)

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Chunked Multipart Upload & Transcoding Queue (AWS MediaConvert)

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Client-side Image Compression & S3 Pre-signed URLs

navigation_confusion.description: User is confused where to click or go next.
navigation_confusion.cross_question:
App complexity kaisi hai?
  1. Super App (Many features)
  2. Single-purpose App

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Bottom Tab Navigation with Global Unified Search

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Linear Flow UX & Contextual Tooltips

battery_drain.cross_question:
Background me kya chal raha hai?
  1. Constant Location tracking (GPS)
  2. Heavy Background Syncing

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Significant-Change Location Service & Geofencing (Low Power)

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: OS-level Background Fetch Scheduler (iOS/Android WorkManager)

storage_bloat.cross_question:
Storage kon kha raha hai?
  1. Cached Media (Images/Videos)
  2. Local Database

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Auto-Expiring LRU Media Cache & Settings to Clear Data

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Database Compaction & Remote Archival

accidental_purchase.cross_question:
Payment ka nature kaisa hai?
  1. In-App Purchase (Digital)
  2. Physical Goods

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Secondary Confirmation Modal & 15-Min Cancellation Window

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: OTP at Checkout & Address Re-verification

localization_pain.description: App not in user's native language.
localization_pain.cross_question:
Kitni languages support karni hain?
  1. Only Left-to-Right (Hindi, English)
  2. Right-to-Left bhi (Arabic, Urdu)

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: i18next Library & JSON Locale Files

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Full RTL Layout Engine Support & Mirrored UX Assets

feature_bloat.cross_question:
Users ka skill level kya hai?
  1. Mix of Novice & Pro
  2. Pure Novice

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: 'Pro Mode' Toggle & Feature Flagging Architecture

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Aggressive Feature Pruning & Minimalist UI Strategy

dark_pattern_anxiety.description: Tricked into subscribing or hidden fees.
dark_pattern_anxiety.cross_question:
Revenue model kya hai?
  1. Subscription
  2. One-time purchases

1.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: 1-Click Unsubscribe & Pre-Renewal Email Alerts

2.exact_value: REQUIREMENT: Clear Price Breakdown & No Hidden Fees Modal
